query: SELECT t.channel_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages m WHERE m.channel_id = t.channel_id AND m.seq > t.lead_last_read_seq AND m.to_kind IN ('lead', 'team') AND NOT (m.type = 'notice' AND m.body->>'kind' = 'lead_unfinished') AND NOT (m.type = 'person_message' AND m.body->>'member' = '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.team_copy_channel = m.channel_id AND i.team_copy_seq = m.seq AND i.execution_status IN ('queued', 'delivered')))) AS "unread!", (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_team_members w WHERE w.team_id = t.id AND w.state IN ('queued', 'starting', 'working')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages q WHERE q.channel_id = t.channel_id AND q.type = 'person_question' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages a WHERE a.channel_id = q.channel_id AND a.type = 'person_answer' AND a.body->>'question_seq' = q.seq::text)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id = t.lead_conversation AND i.team_copy_seq IS NULL AND (i.execution_status IN ('queued', 'sending') OR (i.execution_status = 'delivered' AND i.updated_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = t.lead_conversation AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL), '-infinity'::timestamptz))))) AS "busy!", (SELECT count(*) FROM channel_messages m WHERE m.channel_id = t.channel_id AND m.type = 'notice' AND m.body->>'kind' = 'lead_unfinished' AND m.seq > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(o.seq) FROM channel_messages o WHERE o.channel_id = t.channel_id AND o.author_id = t.lead_conversation::text), 0)) AS "reminded!" FROM agent_teams t WHERE t.lead_conversation = $1 AND t.state = 'running'
